quests.name: Trouble with Bats
quests.summary: The banker wants the bat near Arelburn thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 12 of them close to Arelburn and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Lobster
quests.summary: The general store keeper of Arelburn has run out of raw lobster.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 19 raw lobster and nobody in Arelburn has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Archery Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Arelburn to the archery shop keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the archery shop keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the barber.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Barber
quests.summary: Call on the barber of Arelburn and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the barber and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Arelburn Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Arelburn Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Arelburn Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Zombies
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper wants the zombie near Arelburn thinned out.
intro: The zombie beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 12 of them close to Arelburn and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Raw Tuna
quests.summary: The clothes shop keeper of Arelburn has run out of raw tuna.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 19 raw tuna and nobody in Arelburn has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the General Store Keeper
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Arelburn to the general store keeper.
intro: This should have gone to the general store keeper days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the food shop keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Sweeping the Arelburn Sewers
quests.summary: Clear snake out of Arelburn Sewers and tell the armour shop keeper.
intro: Arelburn Sewers is crawling with snake, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 19 of them, then let the armour shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Arelburn owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Arelburn Sewers is clearer than it was. 19 snake fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: Supply Run to Brackenholt
quests.summary: Gather raw tuna for the general store keeper, then carry a shipment to Brackenholt.
intro: I have an order from Brackenholt and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 19 raw tuna, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the general store keeper in Arelburn.
From Arelburn? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Arelburn and bring back maple logs.
intro: The wilds around Arelburn need a firm hand. Start with 12 spider outside the walls, then 19 giant spider down in Arelburn Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 24 maple logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Arelburn for the sword shop keeper.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the general store keeper, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The sword shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the staff shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the general store keeper.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the magic shop keeper in Arelburn.
From Arelburn? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Arelburn and bring back raw tuna.
intro: The wilds around Arelburn need a firm hand. Start with 12 zombie outside the walls, then 19 king scorpion down in Arelburn Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 19 raw tuna to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

lines: player: The food shop keeper asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the magic shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Arelburn for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the food shop keeper, fight your way through 29 bat and end The Broodmother.
Bring 19 raw lobster back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Arelburn: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.

quests.name: The Arelburn Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Arelburn and Brackenholt.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Brackenholt. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 29 bat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the sword shop keeper in Arelburn.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Brackenholt is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Arelburn has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Arelburn
quests.summary: Find what rules Arelburn Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Arelburn Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the fishing shop keeper what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Arelburn is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Arelburn Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.
